# clyops

> clyops is a one-line-per-option CLI library, with identical behavior in Bash, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C, Go, Ruby and Java. A program's registrations become a machine-readable contract (`--help-json-schema`) that drives help text, validation, config files, shell completion, a dispatcher for directories of tools, an HTTP API, an MCP server for AI agents, and desktop and web runners.

Key facts for agents:

- Every clyops program answers `--help`, `--help-json-schema` (JSON with `"clyops": 1`) and `--completion bash|zsh|fish`. Read the schema before running a tool: it gives options, types, choices, ranges, required values, declared effects (`read-only`, `idempotent`, `destructive`, `network`), stdin/stdout MIME types and which options are secrets.
- Precedence is command line > config file > environment variable (named after the option's variable) > default. Pass secrets through the environment, never on the command line.
- Exit status 1 means invalid input or a runtime failure, with an exact message on stderr. Exit status 2 (Bash and C) means the tool itself is misdefined.
- When writing a tool, register everything before `run` and do no work until `run` returns: it exits early for help, schema, completion and every validation error, and tooling probes tools with those flags.
- Tools served over MCP (`clyops-mcp --root DIR`) are already validated against their schema; declared effects become MCP tool annotations.

## Agent skills

- [clyops-build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/skills/clyops-build/SKILL.md): writing tools with any of the nine libraries, with a reference and complete example per language
- [clyops-use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/skills/clyops-use/SKILL.md): running clyops tools safely from a shell by reading their contract
- [clyops-skillify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/skills/clyops-skillify/SKILL.md): generating skills for a repository's own clyops tools

## Specification

- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/spec/SPEC.md): the behavior contract every implementation follows, including parsing, validation rules, paths, help, schema, dispatchers and JSON input
- [Schema format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/spec/schema.json): JSON Schema of the `--help-json-schema` output

- [Concepts and behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/docs/guide.md): registration, values, validation, config files, commands, relationships, secrets, effects and streams

## Running tools

- [Dispatcher](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/apps/dispatch/README.md): a directory of tools as one command with subcommands, and which programs it will probe
- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/apps/mcp/README.md): a directory of tools as MCP tools, with allow/deny, read-only mode and path confinement
- [HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/apps/api/README.md): a directory of tools as REST endpoints with OpenAPI, jobs and MCP over HTTP
- [Node tools, jobs, API and MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wankdanker/clyops/main/docs/node-tools.md): the Node packages behind them
